title: It breaks my heart to leave this 1 star, but it is what they deserve. Cancelled subscription
text:
As an avid Marvel fan for 40 years, I love everything superhero-related. I jumped into the collector's boxes bandwagon when Amazon started them, and was super stoked when I saw that the first one was going to be Deadpool... but it was *meh*.

I saw that the next one was going to be Venom and I said: I will give it a shot. It was also *meh*. At this point my brain started whispering: "cancel this subscription", but then I saw the next one was going to be MARVEL 10 YEARS, and my heart blocked my brain. "This is going to be EPIC", I thought. Boy how wrong I was...

The person in charge of picking the contents of these boxes has NO IDEA of what the fans want. What a mediocre effort in assembling something so poorly crafted with such a grandiose theme. They could have done so much...

Today, my disappointment is as big as my hopes were for this box. I see that the next one is X-Men (which I also love), but nevertheless... you shall deceive me no more. In the wise words of Gandalf the Grey, I yell to my subscription: "YOU... SHALL NOT PASS".

It surprises me that Amazon (which must be in full damage control mode right now) actually tried to stop me from leaving this review for the past three days. So they know. The question is... will they do something about it?.

The main piece on this "Marvel 10 year celebration box" was the equivalent of a "Star Wars Lifetime Celebration Box" having an oversized Jar Jar Binx pop smiling while giving you the finger. MEESA DON"T LIKE DEES BOXES... ugh!

Until they fix this disaster, stay away from these boxes. All the one star reviews are not jokes. They are truly Charlie Romeo Alpha Papa.
label: negative
